facts.text: China's Feitian extravehicular spacesuit can be worn by people with a height of 1.60 metres to 1.80 metres.
facts.quote: The "Feitian" extravehicular spacesuit developed by China weighs a total weight of 120 kilograms, costs about 30 million yuan, and can be worn by people with a height of 1.60 meters to 1.80 meters, and is divided into 6 layers from the inside to the outside.

facts.text: The Russian Orlan-M extravehicular spacesuit can accommodate wearers with height from 165 cm to 190 cm, i.e. 1.65 metres to 1.90 metres.
facts.quote: The Orlan-M can accommodate a greater range of anthropometric sizes: 165 cm to 190 cm height (instead of 185 cm for the DMA) and up to 112 cm for chest diameter (instead of 108 cm).

facts.text: An Orlan-M EVA spacesuit is approx 70 inches tall, about 1.78 metres.
facts.quote: both clear and protective sun visors, manufactured by NPP Zvezda, approx 70 inches tall and 250 lbs.
